title: SSE/AVX Intrinsics
description: Writes vector code directly with SSE and AVX intrinsics for full control over the instruction stream. Intrinsics map one-to-one to instructions like _mm256_add_ps, processing 8 floats per cycle. It is the fastest path when the compiler will not vectorize on its own.

demo.title: Demo — SSE/AVX Intrinsics

title: AVX-512 Masked Operations
description: Uses AVX-512 mask registers to vectorize loops with conditions and tails. Instead of scalar cleanup code, masked lanes simply do not write, so any loop length vectorizes cleanly. It removes the biggest source of vectorization bugs.

demo.title: Demo — AVX-512 Masked Operations

title: ARM NEON Vectorization
description: Vectorizes hot loops with ARM NEON's 128-bit registers on mobile and embedded cores. NEON processes 4 floats or 16 bytes per instruction, and every modern ARM core has it. Media codecs and ML inference on phones live on NEON.

demo.title: Demo — ARM NEON Vectorization

title: SVE Variable-Length Vectors
description: Writes vector-length-agnostic code with ARM SVE so one binary runs on 128 to 2048-bit implementations. Predication replaces fixed-width assumptions, and the same loop scales with the hardware. It future-proofs vector code across ARM generations.
key_mechanisms: Use predicates instead of fixed widths
Let hardware pick the vector length

demo.title: Demo — SVE Variable-Length Vectors

title: Auto-Vectorization Pragmas
description: Guides the compiler's auto-vectorizer with pragmas and restrict qualifiers. Simple loops vectorize on their own; pragmas resolve the aliasing and dependency questions that block the compiler. It gets most of the speedup with none of the intrinsics.

demo.title: Demo — Auto-Vectorization Pragmas

title: Data Alignment Discipline
description: Aligns arrays to 32 or 64-byte boundaries so vector loads never cross cache lines. Aligned loads are faster and enable aligned-store instructions; posix_memalign and alignas enforce it. Misaligned data can halve vector throughput.

demo.title: Demo — Data Alignment Discipline

title: Gather/Scatter Patterns
description: Uses gather and scatter instructions for non-contiguous data like sparse lookups. AVX2 gathers 8 indexed elements into one register; scatter writes them back. It vectorizes the irregular accesses that defeat simple vectorization.

demo.title: Demo — Gather/Scatter Patterns

title: Horizontal Reduction
description: Reduces a vector register to a scalar with horizontal add/max operations. Dot products and sums accumulate in registers then collapse with a tree reduction. It keeps the whole reduction in registers instead of memory.

demo.title: Demo — Horizontal Reduction

title: Loop Unrolling for Vectors
description: Unrolls loops to expose more independent vector operations to the out-of-order engine. Two or four unrolled iterations hide load latency and fill execution ports. The compiler does this, but manual unrolling controls the exact shape.

demo.title: Demo — Loop Unrolling for Vectors

title: Struct-of-Arrays Layout
description: Reorganizes array-of-structures into struct-of-arrays so vector loads are contiguous. AoS scatters each field across cache lines; SoA packs each field densely. It is the single most impactful layout change for vector code.

demo.title: Demo — Struct-of-Arrays Layout

title: Vectorized Math Libraries
description: Calls vectorized transcendental libraries that compute 8 exps or logs per call. Scalar libm in a vector loop serializes everything; vector math libraries keep the pipeline full. Short-vector math is a solved problem — use the library.

demo.title: Demo — Vectorized Math Libraries

title: Runtime CPU Dispatch
description: Ships multiple vector code paths and picks the best at runtime via CPUID. The binary runs everywhere and uses AVX-512 where present, AVX2 otherwise. Function multiversioning automates the dispatch.

demo.title: Demo — Runtime CPU Dispatch

title: Masked Tail Handling
description: Handles loop tails with masked operations instead of scalar cleanup. The final partial vector processes only its valid lanes, so every element takes the fast path. It removes the branchy tail code that complicates vector loops.

demo.title: Demo — Masked Tail Handling

title: Vector Validation Harnesses
description: Validates vector kernels against scalar references on randomized inputs. Bit-exact or tolerance-checked comparison catches the lane-crossing bugs that only appear at certain alignments. Every vector kernel ships with its harness.

demo.title: Demo — Vector Validation Harnesses

title: Interleaved Multi-Channel Processing
description: Deinterleaves multi-channel data (RGB, stereo audio) into planar vectors for processing. Interleaved data defeats vector loads; a shuffle stage converts to planar, processes at full width, and reinterleaves. Audio and image pipelines depend on it.

demo.title: Demo — Interleaved Multi-Channel Processing
